title: 12-Layer Random Initialization with Relaxed [10,400]nm Bounds
scientific_hypothesis: Random thickness initialization across expanded bounds [10,400]nm will escape local optima that trapped quarter-wave initialized designs, enabling discovery of non-intuitive thickness combinations that better separate dual stopbands from the visible passband.
design_principle: Uniform random sampling across relaxed thickness window followed by gradient-based refinement, building on iteration 27's successful 12-layer topology but with diversified starting points.
manufacturing_considerations: thickness bounds [10,400]nm exceed nominal [20,350]nm for exploration phase
Ta2O5/SiO2 material pair compatible with standard deposition
expected_advantages: Escapes local optima from deterministic initialization
Relaxed bounds allow thicker resonant layers for NIR stopband
Builds on proven 12-layer topology from iteration 27
known_risks: Random initialization may produce invalid candidates requiring more iterations
Thinner layers below 20nm may challenge fabrication repeatability
Wider search space may slow convergence
execution_request_english: Execute TMM optimization for 12-layer Ta2O5/SiO2 alternating stack on fused silica substrate at 0 deg incidence unpolarized. Layer sequence: Ta2O5|SiO2|Ta2O5|SiO2|Ta2O5|SiO2|Ta2O5|SiO2|Ta2O5|SiO2|Ta2O5|SiO2 (12 finite layers). Thickness bounds: [10,400]nm for all layers. Initialize with uniform random sampling across bounds. Optimize to maximize average transmittance in 420-700nm band while minimizing average transmittance in 355-365nm and 1030-1080nm bands and minimizing transmittance at 355nm. Simulation grid: 300-1200nm with 1nm resolution. Use gradient_thickness optimizer with 4 independent runs from different random seeds. Canonical user controls: incidence angles 0 degrees. polarization unpolarized. wavelength intervals 355-355 nm, 355-365 nm, 420-700 nm, 1030-1080 nm. soft objectives: high average transmittance in 420-700 nm; low average transmittance at 355 nm; low average transmittance in 355-365 nm; low average transmittance in 1030-1080 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: high transmittance at 355 nm; high transmittance in 355-365 nm; high transmittance in 1030-1080 nm; high loss in 420-700 nm. manufacturing constraints: maximum 36 layers; layer thickness range 20-350 nm.
revision_reason: Directly implements feedback directive to relax bounds to [10,400]nm and replace quarter-wave initialization with random sampling. Addresses iteration 22 and 29 compilation failures by ensuring bounds compliance and grid coverage.
